Functions with multiple inputs can be analyzed using a technique called "slicing." Which of the following statements accurately describes this process? Select any correct answer.

```{mcq}
#| label: elr-1-jse
1.  It involves holding one or more input variables constant at a fixed value. [correct]
1.  It requires setting the function's output to zero to solve for the intercepts.
1.  It allows you to visualize the relationship between the output and a single input on a standard input vs output graph. [correct]
1.  It calculates the average rate of change for all inputs simultaneously.
1.  It enables some analysis of a multi-variable function as a single-variable function. [correct]
1.  It combines all input variables into a single sum to determine the total magnitude.
```

:::
